name: queria-io
description: Queria open-data tools for Claude Code.

plugins.name: queria
plugins.description: Queria's Japanese open data and public statistics in Claude: the Queria connector (https://mcp.queria.io) reads the data, and the skills add the workflows on top. Find tables, count population and households around a station or address, join across datasets (e-Stat statistics, census small areas, shops and facilities, land prices, corporate registry, postal codes and more), compare places for a location decision (where to open a shop, where to live), write the result up as a page with SQL and charts, and publish datasets of your own with the queria CLI.
